summary: Build practical process safety controls, bowtie analysis, and audit-ready reporting. Train with expert-led workshops and real-world tools.
lede: Process safety management helps high-hazard operations identify major accident hazards and maintain controls that limit escalation. For process safety, operations, plant and HSE professionals, the training supports applying these controls across routine work, maintenance and operational changes. Participants practice hazard analysis and bowtie barrier reviews, management-of-change screening and incident investigation, then use audit planning and process safety indicators to track actions and report progress.
audienceIntro: This advanced process safety management course is designed for professionals who need to control major accident hazards, strengthen barriers, and support audit-ready process safety governance in high-hazard operations.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in operations, maintenance, engineering, HSE, integrity, or production leadership within a high-hazard environment. Prior exposure to process hazard analysis, management of change, incident investigation, or barrier management is helpful, but not mandatory. No coding is required. The advanced content is delivered at operational and applied implementation level, with conceptual coverage only for enterprise-scale analytics or digital twin applications. A laptop is recommended for workshop exercises, and you should be prepared to work with case-based plant data, barrier registers, and audit templates.
